responsibility: Implements core loop-discovery and loop-metadata management for GCC’s natural-loop framework. It owns loop-tree dumping, freeing, nesting queries, identification of loop nodes from headers/latches using dominance information, loop iteration estimate accessors and integer conversions, loop-depth and loop-list traversal support, and basic maintenance helpers such as marking loops for removal; specialized analysis and transformation logic lives in neighboring `cfgloopanal*` and `cfgloopmanip*` files.
same_name_distinction: Implements core natural-loop operations such as loop discovery support, dumping, nesting tests, body membership, and iteration-estimate accessors; unlike gcc/cfgloop.h, it supplies the loop-management code rather than the broad loop data-structure and API declarations used across GCC.
